Maximum donation group: \(500 \times 1200 = 600{,}000\).

Half-sum donation group: three times as many people means \(3 \times 500 = 1500\) people, each giving \(1200/2 = 600\), so:
\(1500 \times 600 = 900{,}000\).

Together these donations total:
\(600{,}000 + 900{,}000 = 1{,}500{,}000\).

This is 40% of the total raised, so if \(T\) is the total:
\(0.4T = 1{,}500{,}000\)

\[
T = \frac{1{,}500{,}000}{0.4} = 3{,}750{,}000
\]

Final answer: 3750000
